caseName: Immigration & Naturalization Service v. Nam Nguyen
caseNameFull: Immigration and Naturalization Service v. Nam Nguyen

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Zadvydas v. Davis, ante, p. 678.
